skins.name: Bittersweet Lulu
skins.desc: A candy witch living on the outskirts of the Peppermint Pine Barrens, Lulu's saccharine enchantments are known to grant incredible powers to any who desire them… but only at great cost to their candy soul.

skins.name: Wicked Lulu
skins.desc: In Runeterra, parents warn their children to obey them, lest they be snatched away in the night by wicked Lulu. There she'll turn them into pixies, making them gather flowers throughout the spooky forest for her wicked schemes!

skins.name: Dragon Trainer Lulu
skins.desc: Dragons, though feared, are still living things and can be befriended under the right circumstances. Lulu enthralled her small friend with whimsical magic... becoming the first ever dragon trainer.

skins.name: Winter Wonder Lulu
skins.desc: A kindly sorceress trailed by her poro pal Pix, Lulu's whimsical ice magic amazes and delights Snowdown revelers everywhere. She's also a skilled fighter, firing deadly glacial spikes and transforming foes into harmless snowmen.

skins.name: Star Guardian Lulu
skins.desc: The youngest member of Lux's team, Lulu is an odd but gifted Star Guardian. Though her unique relationship with the Starlight is sometimes puzzling, Lulu can be counted on to support her team—and let them know that the light supports them, too.

skins.name: Cosmic Enchantress Lulu
skins.desc: Tasked with charting the heavens, Lulu's whimsical splashes of magic dot the sky with newborn stars. She keeps meticulous records of their names, mourning each of them when they finally pass.

skins.name: Pajama Guardian Lulu
skins.desc: Fuzzy onesies! Paper fortune tellers! Cuddly, incoming! Lulu's so ready for this slumber party. Even Pix is excited, and getting into the spirit of things. Star Guardians are destined to protect the universe—but that doesn't mean they can't have a little fun along the way!

skins.name: Space Groove Lulu
skins.desc: Hailing from Boogie Wonderland, a planet of Pure Groove, Lulu is uniquely attuned to the resonance of cosmic disco energy. Using her staff to conjure visions of freedom and abandon to the beat of the music, she can get even the most left-footed creatures in the galaxy tapping along.

skins.name: Prestige Space Groove Lulu
skins.desc: Fresh off a visit from the Three Party Goddesses in the center of the galaxy, Lulu's more in tune with the Groove than ever. Her visions are even more potent, her beats are even more irresistible, and no one knows where Lulu's going to pop up next.

skins.name: Monster Tamer Lulu
skins.desc: Though she's new to the scene, Lulu exemplifies what it means to be a Tamer. She's studied the CORE (Compact Object for Relay and Engagement) manual front to back. She's even used it in the field a few times! Her latest discovery: Zap'Maw, a creature as dangerous as it is adorable.

skins.name: Cafe Cuties Lulu
skins.desc: Sweet tooths are always satisfied when Lulu and her helpful sous-chef Pix are crafting the desserts! Just one whiff of their pastry magic concoctions is enough to enchant even the most unruly customers. Some say their treats are so captivating that they even have reality altering effects…

skins.name: Arcana Lulu
skins.desc: The jester-witch Lulu watches the people below with giddy excitement, eager to see how they receive the whimsical, magical surprises she rains down from on high. Though some suspect the recent disruptions in the Pattern are her doing, those who know Lulu also know that she would never use her art to destroy.

skins.name: Faerie Court Lulu
skins.desc: As summer's reign begins, the Unseelie Lady Lulu whisks bewildered mortals into her idyllic glade to play, play, play! When she grows weary of the game, Lulu transmogrifies her new friends into caterpillar familiars; summer days are long, after all, and bugs make excellent company. Some playmates are simply too precious to be trusted with wings!

lines: We have a set of balance changes coming to Arena this patch as well, nerfing some of the strongest or most meta dominant champions, and buffing weaker ones and alternative play options (like AP Bel'veth and Tristana or Q Nuke Lulu)! We've also changed up some of the items to make sure that those of you interested in theorycrafting unique builds have some perplexing new options!
• Second Hit Damage: Reduced by 25% ⇒ Increased by 25%
• Fixed a bug where Lulu’s Faerie Companion (Passive) glowing model VFX disappeared after disconnecting and reconnecting.
Faerie Court Bel'Veth, Faerie Court Gwen, and Faerie Court Lulu will be available August 12, 2026.
Faerie Court Lulu & Faerie Court Gwen
• Fixed a bug where Pix was always visible as one from Base skin if Neeko disguised as Lulu.
